Glossary ​

中文术语表。 These terms describe the implemented responsibility layers, not directory names. Architecture sections are in Architecture.

术语English定义file:line
故障规格FaultSpecA tagged model for latency, loss, or disconnect semantics shared by the user boundary, coordinator, agent, and adapters.crates/core/src/lib.rs:26
故障目标TargetThe optional IPv4 source, destination, and destination-port selectors that scope one injection.crates/core/src/lib.rs:44
注入请求InjectionOne fault plus one target; this pair is the shared execution contract.crates/core/src/lib.rs:82
内在校验intrinsic validationChecks fault ranges, non-empty targets, and IPv6 support before backend-specific behavior runs.crates/core/src/lib.rs:108
管理网段保护management-network protectionRejects a target whose networks overlap operator-provided protected CIDRs.crates/core/src/lib.rs:142
执行器端口CommandExecutorThe netem adapter's boundary for running or recording tc commands; production and test executors implement it.crates/netem/src/lib.rs:73
tc 命令TcCommandA reproducible program-and-arguments representation of one traffic-control operation.crates/netem/src/lib.rs:56
netem 适配器NetemAdapterPlans, applies, and rolls back qdisc/filter state for latency and loss on one interface.crates/netem/src/lib.rs:172
pilot qdiscpilot qdiscFaultDeck-owned root qdisc handle 100: used to recognize and safely remove only its own traffic-control state.crates/netem/src/lib.rs:13
断连路由disconnect routingThe agent routes a disconnect injection to iptables instead of tc; other faults go to netem.crates/agent/src/lib.rs:196
iptables 链iptables chainThe FAULTDECK mangle chain and its INPUT jump carry disconnect DROP rules.crates/agent/src/firewall.rs:9
断连适配器disconnect adapterIptables ensures the chain, installs DROP rules, and performs idempotent rollback.crates/agent/src/firewall.rs:31
Agent 配置AgentConfigProcess-start settings: bind address, optional token, target interface, and management networks.crates/agent/src/lib.rs:90
单活动故障single active faultAgent-host state that rejects a second injection until rollback clears the adapter marker.crates/agent/src/lib.rs:191
Agent 线请求agent wire requestThe tagged ping, inject, or rollback payload decoded by the agent host.crates/agent/src/lib.rs:109
Agent 线响应agent wire responseThe tagged ok or error result returned to the CLI.crates/agent/src/lib.rs:117
令牌鉴权token authenticationOptional shared-secret comparison at each process boundary; an unset token means auth is disabled.crates/agent/src/lib.rs:124
NDJSON 帧NDJSON frameA newline-delimited JSON value with a hard 64 KiB frame ceiling.crates/agent/src/transport.rs:56
Mode AMode AAgent-listens topology: the controller opens one TCP stream to the resident target agent.crates/agent/src/transport.rs:94
Mode BMode BController-listens reverse-connect topology with retry and backoff for NAT traversal.crates/agent/src/transport.rs:118
中枢信封WireMessageThe coordinator envelope carrying an optional token and one control command.crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:235
中枢命令AgentCommandRegister, heartbeat, inject, rollback, fetch-report, or list-agents operations accepted by the coordinator.crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:69
中枢响应AgentResponseCoordinator acknowledgement, queue receipt, registry listing, report, or error result.crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:80
Agent 身份AgentIdentityAn agent ID, capability list, last-seen timestamp, and list-time online flag stored by the coordinator.crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:51
心跳heartbeatUpdates one registered agent's last_seen_ms; freshness feeds the online check.crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:178
Agent 链路agent linkThe agent's outbound connection to the coordinator; LinkMessage::Dispatch goes down it, Result/Heartbeat come back up.crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:134
在线状态online statusLink liveness OR a heartbeat within HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS (30 s); offline agents are excluded from available.crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:211
指令入队queued commandWhen the target agent is offline, inject/rollback persist in its queue and are dispatched on its next registration.crates/coordinator/src/lib.rs:351
场景ScenarioA named injection whose stable serialization is the input to hashing and reporting.crates/report/src/lib.rs:38
场景哈希scenario hashThe SHA-256 identity of a scenario, used for report lookup and comparison.crates/report/src/lib.rs:49
运行报告RunReportThe canonical result model containing scenario identity, timestamps, evidence, and replay text.crates/report/src/lib.rs:78
回放命令replay commandA shell-quoted CLI invocation generated by the user boundary and stored in the report.crates/cli/src/main.rs:315
恢复证据restore evidenceA timestamped post-rollback check with pass/fail and detail fields.crates/report/src/lib.rs:63
外部断言external assertionA named externally observed result attached to a run report.crates/report/src/lib.rs:71
历史 diffhistorical diffA structural comparison of two reports' event, evidence, and assertion collections.crates/report/src/lib.rs:175
